phase: Post-simulation explanatory audit of fresh isolated-package runs; no simulations or original-log imports.

drop_coverage.qualification: Manifest coverage is not an independent audit of every loss path.

packet_witnesses.qualification: Each claim uses the exact original transmission tag, pre-processing expected_seq, and same-time ordered receiver application delivery. Wire receipt or absence of observed drops alone is insufficient. ACK arrival at the sender may lag application delivery. These witnesses do not establish a universal loss-path audit or the physical cause of the route-neighborhood reordering.
